messages:
alex.c: Quick check — wave-3 dedicated capacity handoff in ~12 days. Where are we on the final 8 H100s? Also need rack power sequencing confirmed (PDUs + BMS). Who's owning the last-mile items and blockers?

maria_p: Vendor update: 4 units shipped, 4 on hold pending export docs. ETA on hold clear is Fri EOD (est). Escalating with vendor ops now. @alex.c I'll drop the docs here when I have them.

samuel: Staging readiness: VLANs done for new racks, switch ACLs applied. Remaining: IMS tagging + BMC firmware on 2 racks. Without firmware we can't run full burn-in.

ravi_s: I'll take BMC/firmware work. Can we slot patches Tue 00:00-04:00 UTC? Need DC access approved and PDUs to be labeled in DC ticket before patching.

jonathan_k: Runtime question — when do you want the agent image pushed to wave-3 nodes? If we push pre-burn-in we can canary-detect regressions during burn-in. Prefer a staged rollout.

maria_p: Export docs expected Thu morning PST. If confirmed, logistics will attempt overnight ship. Will post tracking IDs here.

alex.c: Action items (short):
1) @maria_p confirm export docs by Thu 12:00 PT
2) @ravi_s schedule BMC patch Tue 00:00-04:00 UTC and add PDU tagging req to DC ticket
3) @jonathan_k coordinate agent canary during burn-in; we'll announce windows to QA
4) infra-bot create DC tickets for PDUs & circuit reservations

samuel: Quick note — fallback plan if vendor hold persists: accept 4 fewer units and enable soft-fallback to reserved burst pool. Need confirmation which customers get degraded capacity. @alex.c can product approve?

alex.c: Fallback plan B is acceptable but we need product sign-off on customer prioritization by Fri. I'll follow up with product and report back.

samuel: Example reservation command I'll use for planning: 
```
res-create --id RESV-2024 --start 2026-03-25T00:00Z --duration 30d --nodes 8
```

infra-bot: Created ticket DC-4821 (PDUs tagging) and RESV-2024 (circuit reservation start 2026-03-25).

maria_p: Uploading proof-of-export.pdf to vendor-share (link) — DMing ship manifest to ops.

jonathan_k: I'll prepare a reduced-batch runtime profile for the 4-unit scenario and open a PR against runtime-configs with the diffs. Canary plan ready once burn-in window is locked.

ravi_s: PDU vendor requires final rack list by Wed 12:00 PT. Please ping me with any rack swaps before then.

alex.c: Thanks all — I'll capture these action items and bring a brief update to tomorrow's eng-infra stand. :thumbsup:
